content.comment_body: Hi, Is it possible to adjust values such as offsets or constants using the cursor keys on the [product_name] device? I have a temperature sensor and a setpoint for desired temperature. When the actual temperature exceeds the setpoint, a fan activates. I want to be able to change the desired temperature using the cursor keys, but I'm not sure how to achieve this. Thank you in advance.

There are two ways to change the setpoint using the cursor keys: 1) One method involves using an arithmetic function. You can link parameters (such as V1) in a message text and set it as an input field. This allows direct adjustment of the value from the device display using cursor keys during parameter entry. 2) Alternatively, you can use the cursor keys to control an up/down counter to modify the value.
Both approaches are included in the attachment.
Thank you! The first method seems suitable for my needs.

analysis.insight_summary: The thread covers methods for changing setpoint and parameter values directly on the [product_name] device display using cursor keys. Quick, intuitive modification through hardware controls is a priority, especially for adjusting operational parameters like desired temperature in automation setups. Guidance provided resolved the user's query, indicating initial uncertainty was due to unfamiliarity, not device limitation.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects to modify setpoints or constants conveniently and rapidly using cursor keys directly on the device display, without requiring additional devices or navigating complex menus.
